chunks.content: PICARD Well then... only one way to go. He swings the Scorpion around again so it is facing the doors they came through, the doors back into the ship. Data is dubious. DATA Do you think this is a wise course of action? PICARD We're about to find out... Power up disruptors and fire on my mark. DATA Ready, Captain. PICARD Fire! And the Scorpion's forward disruptors fire! The doors into the ship explode! Picard powers forward!

metadata.title: 206、INT. SCORPION COCKPIT - SHUTTLEBAY - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard reverses the Scorpion, fires disruptors to destroy the shuttlebay doors, and powers forward into the ship despite Data's hesitation.

document_metadata.title: 207、INT. SCIMITAR CORRIDORS - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Scorpion speeds down the corridor, narrowly avoiding stunned Remans, as Picard maintains control after scraping the wall.

chunks.content: And the Scorpion shoots into the corridor, past the stunned Remans. Picard banks sharply -- careens off the far side of the corridor but keeps control. The Scorpion zooms down the corridor.

metadata.title: 207、INT. SCIMITAR CORRIDORS - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Scorpion speeds down the corridor, narrowly avoiding stunned Remans, as Picard maintains control after scraping the wall.

document_metadata.title: 208、INT. SCORPION COCKPIT - SCIMITAR - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard is intensely focused, struggling to control something as fast and unpredictable as the world's fastest roller coaster.

chunks.content: Picard is concentrating intensely -- it is like trying to control the world's fastest roller coaster.

metadata.title: 208、INT. SCORPION COCKPIT - SCIMITAR - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard is intensely focused, struggling to control something as fast and unpredictable as the world's fastest roller coaster.

document_metadata.title: 209、INT. SCIMITAR - CORRIDORS - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Scorpion navigates the ship rapidly, making sharp turns at high speed.

chunks.content: The Scorpion banks around a corner --it zigs and zags through the ship at breakneck speed --

metadata.title: 209、INT. SCIMITAR - CORRIDORS - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Scorpion navigates the ship rapidly, making sharp turns at high speed.

document_metadata.title: 210、INT. SCIMITAR - OBSERVATION LOUNGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The Scorpion bursts through the observation lounge doors, shoots upward, shatters the glass dome, and exits triumphantly into space.

chunks.content: The doors to the observation lounge EXPLODE in. The Scorpion SHOOTS into the room and up -- A disruptor blast SHATTERS the etched glass dome at the top of the room -- And the Scorpion ZOOMS triumphantly into space!

metadata.title: 210、INT. SCIMITAR - OBSERVATION LOUNGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: The Scorpion bursts through the observation lounge doors, shoots upward, shatters the glass dome, and exits triumphantly into space.

document_metadata.title: 211、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Scorpion emerges suddenly, cutting through the Scimitar's invisibility cloak.

chunks.content: The Scorpion seems to appear from nowhere -- slicing through the cloak of invisibility around the Scimitar --

metadata.title: 211、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Scorpion emerges suddenly, cutting through the Scimitar's invisibility cloak.

document_metadata.title: 212、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The crew spots the Scorpion on the viewscreen and Riker orders Worf to lock transporters.

chunks.content: The crew sees the Scorpion appear on the viewscreen. RIKER Worf! Lock on transporters!

metadata.title: 212、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The crew spots the Scorpion on the viewscreen and Riker orders Worf to lock transporters.

document_metadata.title: 213、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon spots the Scorpion and orders a tractor beam to be activated immediately.

chunks.content: Shinzon sees the Scorpion as well. SHINZON Tractor beam! Now!

metadata.title: 213、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon spots the Scorpion and orders a tractor beam to be activated immediately.

document_metadata.title: 214、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Scorpion dematerializes before they can act, making their efforts too late.

chunks.content: But they are too late -- the Scorpion dematerializes --

metadata.title: 214、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Scorpion dematerializes before they can act, making their efforts too late.

document_metadata.title: 215、INT. ENTERPRISE - CARGO BAY - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard and Data arrive in the Enterprise's cargo bay and immediately request emergency warp from the first officer.

chunks.content: And materializes in one of the Enterprise's cargo bays. Picard and Data climb out -- PICARD (to comm) Number One, emergency warp!

metadata.title: 215、INT. ENTERPRISE - CARGO BAY - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard and Data arrive in the Enterprise's cargo bay and immediately request emergency warp from the first officer.

document_metadata.title: 216、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise rolls in a dramatic arc, enters warp upside down, and vanishes in a burst of light.

chunks.content: The Enterprise dramatically powers forward and up -- rolling over in a great arc going into warp while still upside down. It disappears in a blaze of light. Fade to...

metadata.title: 216、EXT. OVER ROMULUS - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Enterprise rolls in a dramatic arc, enters warp upside down, and vanishes in a burst of light.

document_metadata.title: 217、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, mirroring Picard's mannerism, declares the Federation will be crippled in two days and threatens Suran over lack of respect upon his return.

chunks.content: Shinzon sits in his command chair as the ship streaks through space. He speaks on viewscreen with his Romulan collaborators. His face is even more finely veined now. SHINZON The Enterprise is immaterial! They won't make it back to Federation space. SURAN (ON VIEWSCREEN) (angry) This has gone far enough! SHINZON I thought we discussed patience, Commander. SURAN (ON VIEWSCREEN) And mine is wearing thin, young man! We supported you because you promised action. And yet you delay and you waste your time playing games with Picard while --

metadata.title: 217、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon, mirroring Picard's mannerism, declares the Federation will be crippled in two days and threatens Suran over lack of respect upon his return.

chunks.content: Shinzon stands and briskly pulls down his uniform tunic exactly as we've seen Picard do a thousand times. SHINZON Commander Suran, the games are over. In two days the Federation will be crippled beyond repair. Does that satisfy you? SURAN (ON VIEWSCREEN) (grim) For the moment.SHINZON (brutal) And when I return... you and I shall have a little talk about showing proper respect!

metadata.title: 217、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon, mirroring Picard's mannerism, declares the Federation will be crippled in two days and threatens Suran over lack of respect upon his return.

document_metadata.title: 218、INT. ROMULAN SENATE - CHAMBER - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Donatra challenges the Romulan leaders' support for Shinzon, warning of bloodshed and lasting consequences if they enable his ruthless mission.

chunks.content: The viewscreen picture of Shinzon snaps out. The Romulan sit for a silent beat. DONATRA Does anyone in this room harbor any illusions about what he means by "showing proper respect"? TAL'AURA What's happening to his face? SURAN I want opinions. He is clearly out of his mind. SURAN But can he complete his mission? DONATRA Should he? They look at her. DONATRA Are you prepared to have your hands drenched in blood? He'll show them no mercy. And his sins will mark us all for generations. Is that what you truly want, Romulans? A beat. DONATRA I think you should consider that question now -- or else you may have a lifetime to think about it in the dilithium mines. She turns and stalks out.

metadata.title: 218、INT. ROMULAN SENATE - CHAMBER - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Donatra challenges the Romulan leaders' support for Shinzon, warning of bloodshed and lasting consequences if they enable his ruthless mission.

document_metadata.title: 219、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon is dying due to accelerated decay from flawed aging; only Picard's complete blood infusion can save him, motivating Shinzon to capture Picard as a donor.

chunks.content: Beverly sits with Picard and Riker. BEVERLY The more I studied his DNA the more confusing it got. Finally I could only come to one conclusion... Shinzon was created with temporal RNA sequencing. He was designed so that at a certain point his aging process could be accelerated to reach your age more quickly, so he could replace you. PICARD But the Romulans abandoned the plan... BEVERLY As a result the temporal sequencing was never activated. Remember, he was supposed to replace you at nearly your current age. He was engineered to skip thirty years of life. But since the RNA sequencing was never activated, his cellular structure has started to break down. He's dying.

metadata.title: 219、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon is dying due to accelerated decay from flawed aging; only Picard's complete blood infusion can save him, motivating Shinzon to capture Picard as a donor.

chunks.content: PICARD Dying? RIKER He wasn't designed to live a complete, human life span. PICARD Can anything be done for him? BEVERLY Not without a complete myelodysplastic infusion from the only donor with compatible DNA. But that would mean draining all your blood. RIKER That's why he went to all that trouble to capture you. PICARD How long does he have? BEVERLY I can't be sure but the rate of decay seems to be accelerating. Picard considers this.PICARD Then he'll come for me as a donor.

metadata.title: 219、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon is dying due to accelerated decay from flawed aging; only Picard's complete blood infusion can save him, motivating Shinzon to capture Picard as a donor.

document_metadata.title: 220、INT. ENTERPRISE - DATA'S CABIN - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Data deactivates the B-9 android indefinitely after confirming it lacks information on Shinzon's plans and ship tactics, calling it 'brother' before shutting it down.

chunks.content: Data stands before the B-9. The B-9 has been deactivated, he stands lifeless and immobile. Data gazes deeply into his double's identical features. Then he opens a panel in the B-9's neck and uses a small instrument to activate the android's head. The B-9's eyes spring to life. He looks at Data. B- Brother. I cannot move. DATA No, I have only activated your cognitive and communication subroutines. B- Why? DATA Because you are dangerous. B- Why? DATA You have been programmed to gather information that can be used against this ship. B- I do not understand. DATA I know.

metadata.title: 220、INT. ENTERPRISE - DATA'S CABIN - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Data deactivates the B-9 android indefinitely after confirming it lacks information on Shinzon's plans and ship tactics, calling it 'brother' before shutting it down.

chunks.content: A beat. DATA Do you know anything about Shinzon's plans against the Federation? B- No. DATA Do you have any knowledge of the tactical abilities of his ship? B- No. Can I move now? DATA No. I must deactivate you. B- For how long? DATA Indefinitely. B- How long is that? A beat. Data gazes at the B-9 deeply. DATA A long time, brother. Data reaches forward and deactivates his brother. The B-9's eyes lose the spark of life. He stands, frozen.

metadata.title: 220、INT. ENTERPRISE - DATA'S CABIN - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Data deactivates the B-9 android indefinitely after confirming it lacks information on Shinzon's plans and ship tactics, calling it 'brother' before shutting it down.

document_metadata.title: 221、INT. ENTERPRISE - OBSERVATION LOUNGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Picard prepares the Enterprise for battle, prioritizing stopping Shinzon's biogenic weapon; the ship is expendable. Starfleet converges in sector 3274.

chunks.content: Picard is gathered with his senior officers. A computer display illustrates Geordi's words about the power of Shinzon's weapon. We see a chilling graphic of the Biogenic Pulse beam spreading around a ship, then a whole planet. GEORDI It's called a Cascading Biogenic Pulse. The unique properties of Thalaron radiation allow the energy beam to expand almost without limits. Depending on the radiant intensity it could encompass a ship... or a planet. PICARD (thinking) And that's exactly what he's going to do. RIKER Sir? PICARD His hatred of the Federation is apparent. He would have built a weapon of that scope for one reason. He is going after Earth. RIKER Oh boy. Destroy humanity and the Federation is crippled... PICARD And the Romulans invade. DEANNA How can you be certain? PICARD I know how he thinks.

metadata.title: 221、INT. ENTERPRISE - OBSERVATION LOUNGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard prepares the Enterprise for battle, prioritizing stopping Shinzon's biogenic weapon; the ship is expendable. Starfleet converges in sector 3274.

chunks.content: A beat. RIKER (to Geordi) And there's no way to penetrate his cloak? GEORDI No, sir. RIKER (frustrated) He could pass within 10 meters of every ship in Starfleet and they'd never know. BEVERLY But we do have one advantage. (to Picard) He needs your blood to live. He might come after you first. PICARD I'm counting on it... We've been ordered to head to sector 3274. Starfleet is diverting the fleet to meet us there. RIKER Strength in numbers? PICARD We can only hope so. A beat as he looks at them gravely. PICARD He can't be allowed to use that weapon. All other concerns are secondary. Do you understand me? Riker knows exactly what Picard is saying: the Enterprise is expendable. RIKER Yes, sir.Picard stands. Presses a comm button. PICARD All hands. Battle stations.

metadata.title: 221、INT. ENTERPRISE - OBSERVATION LOUNGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard prepares the Enterprise for battle, prioritizing stopping Shinzon's biogenic weapon; the ship is expendable. Starfleet converges in sector 3274.

document_metadata.title: 222、INT. ENTERPRISE - VARIOUS ANGLES
document_metadata.summary: Picard calmly moves through the ship, reassuring crew members, while reflecting in his log on the crew's dedication and the impending confrontation as they head to Federation space at maximum warp.

chunks.content: We see a montage of the Enterprise preparing for battle. Crew members assume battle stations. Weapons locker rings open and Security Officers hand out sidearms and phaser rifles. Geordi and his Engineers establish emergency force fields around the warp core. Riker and Worf brief officers on tactical plans. Data works at the bridge Science Station, analyzing data on Shinzon's ship. Every department readies itself with precision and urgency, reflecting the disciplined nature of Starfleet under pressure. The ship transforms into a fortress, its systems aligned for combat.

metadata.title: 222、INT. ENTERPRISE - VARIOUS ANGLES
metadata.summary: Picard calmly moves through the ship, reassuring crew members, while reflecting in his log on the crew's dedication and the impending confrontation as they head to Federation space at maximum warp.

chunks.content: Picard walks through the corridors, moving calmly among the crew. He stops to talk with an apprehensive young ensign, offering a few quiet words of reassurance. His presence is steady, a grounding force amid the tension. As he continues on his way, we hear: PICARD (V.O.) Captain's Personal Log. Supplemental. We're heading toward Federation space at maximum warp. The crew has responded with the dedication I've come to expect of them. And like a thousand other commanders on a thousand other battlefields throughout history, I wait for the dawn.

metadata.title: 222、INT. ENTERPRISE - VARIOUS ANGLES
metadata.summary: Picard calmly moves through the ship, reassuring crew members, while reflecting in his log on the crew's dedication and the impending confrontation as they head to Federation space at maximum warp.

document_metadata.title: 223、INT. ENTERPRISE - SICKBAY - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Picard reflects on identity and change with Dr. Crusher, who asserts that someone is not him, prompting a contemplative exchange on what defines a person.

chunks.content: Picard enters sickbay. Dr. Crusher and her medical staff are hard at work. They position anti-grav gurneys and ready medical supplies. Security officers are handing out phasers. Picard watches the grim preparations. Beverly goes to him, bolstering her phaser. PICARD (quietly) To seek out new life and new civilizations. Zephyr Cochran's own words. When Charles Darwin set out on the H.M.S. Beagle, on his journey into the unknown... he sailed without a single musket.

metadata.title: 223、INT. ENTERPRISE - SICKBAY - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard reflects on identity and change with Dr. Crusher, who asserts that someone is not him, prompting a contemplative exchange on what defines a person.

chunks.content: BEVERLY (gently) That was another time. PICARD How far we've come. Let me know if you need anything. He starts to go -- BEVERLY Jean Luc... (he stops) ... He is not you. A beat. PICARD What makes us who we are, Doctor? Can you tell me that? She watches him go.

metadata.title: 223、INT. ENTERPRISE - SICKBAY - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard reflects on identity and change with Dr. Crusher, who asserts that someone is not him, prompting a contemplative exchange on what defines a person.

document_metadata.title: 224、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, satisfied with seven minutes to the Rift, sees the Enterprise shockingly close on the viewscreen as he prepares to return to Romulus.

chunks.content: Shinzon sits in his command chair, lined with veins now. His Viceroy again has his hand pressed to Shinzon's chest. SHINZON How long? VICEROY A matter of hours now -- Shinzon shoves him away. Stands. VICEROY If you don't begin the procedure soon you'll never make it back to Romulus. You shouldn't have delayed. You should have killed Picard the moment -- Shinzon slams his command chair in fury. The Viceroy watches him carefully. A beat. Shinzon regains his composure. He sits again in his command chair.

metadata.title: 224、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon, satisfied with seven minutes to the Rift, sees the Enterprise shockingly close on the viewscreen as he prepares to return to Romulus.

chunks.content: SHINZON How long until we reach the Rift? VICEROY (checks a console) Seven minutes. Shinzon leans back, satisfied. And looks at the viewscreen. The image on the viewscreen is shocking. The Enterprise only a few hundred yards away.

metadata.title: 224、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon, satisfied with seven minutes to the Rift, sees the Enterprise shockingly close on the viewscreen as he prepares to return to Romulus.

document_metadata.title: 225、EXT. ENTERPRISE - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise travels through space, unaware of a predator lurking above it.

chunks.content: The Enterprise zooms through space. Completely unaware of the predator directly above it.

metadata.title: 225、EXT. ENTERPRISE - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise travels through space, unaware of a predator lurking above it.

document_metadata.title: 226、INT. ENTERPRISE - ASTROMETRICS - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Picard muses on Shinzon's potential if raised differently; the Enterprise's projections fail due to the Bassen Rift, and the ship is suddenly attacked by a photon torpedo.

chunks.content: Data is at work in Astrometry. Cartographic projections of star systems ebb and flow on a large screen before him. Picard enters. PICARD Show me our current position. The images before them quickly change to show another sector and a blip representing the Enterprise. PICARD How long until we reach the fleet? DATA At our current velocity we will arrive at sector 3274 in approximately 40 minutes. The images before them change to show sector 3274. We see blips denoting Starfleet ships moving into position. Picard gazes at the projection of stars before them for a moment. PICARD (quietly) \"For now we see but through a glass darkly...\" He said he's a mirror. DATA Of you? PICARD Yes. DATA I do not agree. Although you share the same genetic structure, the events of your life have created unique individual. PICARD But so much is the same. On a biological level he is... and I will not accept the idea that there is nothing I can do. I have a responsibility to try to make a human connection with him. DATA He would deny a \"human\" connection is possible. He considers himself entirely Reman. PICARD He may have already rejected my humanity, but you also have a twin. DATA No, sir, it is not possible. The B-9 is physically identical to me, although his neural pathways are not as advanced. But even if they were, he would not be me. PICARD How can you be sure? DATA I aspire, sir. To be better than I am. The B-9 does not. Nor does Shinzon.

metadata.title: 226、INT. ENTERPRISE - ASTROMETRICS - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard muses on Shinzon's potential if raised differently; the Enterprise's projections fail due to the Bassen Rift, and the ship is suddenly attacked by a photon torpedo.

chunks.content: A beat. PICARD We'll never know what Shinzon might have been. Had he stood where I did as a child? And looked up at the stars. Picard's words linger in the air for a moment. Then the projections before them sputter with static for a moment. Flickering. DATA (working controls) We are passing through the Bassen Rift. The projections will return when we have cleared it. PICARD It's interfering with our uplink from Starfleet cartography? DATA Yes, sir. The Rift effects all long-range communications --PICARD (urgent, to comm) Commander Riker, evasive maneuvers! Too late. The ship QUAKES -- a photon torpedo blast -- the Enterprise is under attack!

metadata.title: 226、INT. ENTERPRISE - ASTROMETRICS - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Picard muses on Shinzon's potential if raised differently; the Enterprise's projections fail due to the Bassen Rift, and the ship is suddenly attacked by a photon torpedo.

document_metadata.title: 227、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: Disruptor beams hit the Enterprise, forcing it out of warp in the electromagnetically distorted Bassen Rift.

chunks.content: Disruptor beams appear from nowhere -- streaking through space -- slamming into the Enterprise's warp drive. The Enterprise recoils, dangerously dropping out of warp in a furious lurch. The Bassen Rift is a strange area of electromagnetic distortion. Energy patterns crackle through space.

metadata.title: 227、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: Disruptor beams hit the Enterprise, forcing it out of warp in the electromagnetically distorted Bassen Rift.

document_metadata.title: 228、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon orders weapons fired at the Enterprise, aiming to disable but not destroy it, while taunting Captain Picard.

chunks.content: Shinzon sits in his command chair. The viewscreen shows the Enterprise before him. SHINZON Target weapons systems and shields. I don't want the Enterprise destroyed. On the viewscreen, we see disruptor blasts streaking from the Scimitar -- slicing into the Enterprise. SHINZON Can you learn to see in the dark, Captain?

metadata.title: 228、INT. SCIMITAR BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon orders weapons fired at the Enterprise, aiming to disable but not destroy it, while taunting Captain Picard.

document_metadata.title: 229、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard and Data respond to an attack by an enemy ship firing through a cloak; the Enterprise is disabled, losing warp drive and long-range communication, and prepares to fire phasers.

chunks.content: Picard and Data emerge from the turbolift as the ship ROCKS -- PICARD Report. RIKER He's firing through his cloak. We can't get a lock. GEORDI (at engineering station) He disabled our warp drive with his first shot. We've only got impulse. WORF Long range communication is impossible as long as we're in the rift -- The ship SHUDDERS again -- PICARD Worf, prepare a full phaser spread, zero elevation. All banks on my mark. Scan for shield impacts and stand by photon torpedoes. WORF Aye, sir The ship ROCKS again. PICARD Fire!

metadata.title: 229、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard and Data respond to an attack by an enemy ship firing through a cloak; the Enterprise is disabled, losing warp drive and long-range communication, and prepares to fire phasers.

document_metadata.title: 230、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise fires phasers and photon torpedoes at the Scimitar, but the torpedoes pass through its momentarily visible shield location, indicating evasive or cloaking capabilities.

chunks.content: The Enterprise fires her phasers simultaneously -- the energy beams shoot into space -- And the Scimitar's shape is momentarily illuminated as one of its shields is hit. Photon torpedoes immediately shoot from the Enterprise -- but pass harmlessly through the area where the Scimitar's shields were momentarily illuminated.

metadata.title: 230、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise fires phasers and photon torpedoes at the Scimitar, but the torpedoes pass through its momentarily visible shield location, indicating evasive or cloaking capabilities.

document_metadata.title: 231、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon criticizes his opponent's speed and initiates Attack Pattern Shinzon Theta via his chair console.

chunks.content: SHINZON You're too slow, old man. (entering commands in his chair console) Attack pattern Shinzon Theta.

metadata.title: 231、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon criticizes his opponent's speed and initiates Attack Pattern Shinzon Theta via his chair console.

document_metadata.title: 232、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The invisible Warbird conducts a brutal, close-range assault by firing steadily while making a dramatic pass over the Enterprise.

chunks.content: The invisible Warbird makes a dramatic run straight over the Enterprise -- firing steadily down as it sweeps past it; is a brutal, close range assault --

metadata.title: 232、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The invisible Warbird conducts a brutal, close-range assault by firing steadily while making a dramatic pass over the Enterprise.

document_metadata.title: 233、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The bridge shakes as dorsal shields fail; Picard orders a port rotation and ventral phaser fire to counter the attack.

chunks.content: The bridge SHAKES violently under the ruthless attack-- DATA We are losing dorsal shields -- PICARD Full axis rotation to port! Fire all ventral phasers!

metadata.title: 233、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The bridge shakes as dorsal shields fail; Picard orders a port rotation and ventral phaser fire to counter the attack.

document_metadata.title: 234、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise rolls left and fires phasers upward, briefly illuminating the Scimitar's shields as it passes overhead.

chunks.content: The Enterprise instantly complies -- Rolling completely over to the left, firing phasers up as Shinzon's invisible ship streaks above it -- A few lucky phaser shots from the bottom of the Enterprise -- now shooting upward -- manage to momentarily illuminate the bottom shields of the Scimitar as it sweeps past above.

metadata.title: 234、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise rolls left and fires phasers upward, briefly illuminating the Scimitar's shields as it passes overhead.

document_metadata.title: 235、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise faces the Scimitar; Shinzon hails Picard, requesting a meeting in the Ready Room while Riker and Worf address defensive actions.

chunks.content: WORF Minimal damage to the Scimitar. RIKER (to Helm) Defensive pattern Kirk Epsilon. Geordi, get those shields online. PICARD (to comm) Counselor Troi, report to the bridge. RIKER Unless we can disable his cloak we're just going to be firing in the dark. PlCARD Agreed. WORF Sir, we're being hailed. PICARD On screen. Shinzon appears on the viewscreen. He is on the bridge of the Scimitar. SHINZON (ON VIEWSCREEN) Captain Picard, will you join me in your Ready Room?

metadata.title: 235、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Enterprise faces the Scimitar; Shinzon hails Picard, requesting a meeting in the Ready Room while Riker and Worf address defensive actions.

document_metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

chunks.content: Picard stands in his Ready Room. A flickering light shimmers across the room. And a perfect holographic representation of Shinzon appears before him. SHINZON You can't trace my holographic emitters, Captain. So don't bother. And you can't contact Starfleet. We're quite alone. PICARD We are. SHINZON It's just the two of us now, Jean Luc, as it should be... Your ship and mine... You and me. PICARD Why are you here? SHINZON To accept your surrender. I can clearly destroy you at any time. Lower your shields and allow me to transport you to my ship. PICARD And what of the Enterprise? SHINZON I have little interest in your quaint vessel, Captain. If the Enterprise will withdraw to a distance of one hundred light years, it will not be harmed. PICARD You know that's not possible. SHINZON I know... you'll all gladly die to save your home world. PICARD (intense) Look at me, Shinzon! Do you feel the blood pumping inside you? Your hands, your eyes, your nature, are the same as mine. Buried deep inside you beneath the years of pain and anger is a capacity you've forgotten. It's the one way our mirror can reflect the two of us exactly because it's the very thing that truly defines us. To be human is to try to make yourself better than you are. Picard looks at him deeply, relentlessly refusing to give up. PICARD I know you as well as I know myself, Shinzon. There was a time you looked at the stars and dreamed of what might be. SHINZON (quietly) Long ago. PICARD Not so long. SHINZON Childish dreams, Captain. Lost in the dilithium mines of Remus. I'm what you see now. PICARD I see more than what you are.

metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

chunks.content: Picard steps toward him. PICARD I see what you could be. Shinzon slowly backs away as Picard continues to move toward him relentlessly. PICARD The man who is Jean Luc Picard and Shinzon of Remus won't exterminate the population of an entire planet! He is better than that! SHINZON (desperate) He is what his life has made him! Shinzon is in turmoil. Picard senses this. He proceeds quietly: PICARD And what will he do with that life? Shinzon looks at him, questioning. PICARD If I were to beam to your ship... let you complete your medical procedure, give you a full life... what would you do with the time? Shinzon doesn't respond. PICARD You once asked me about your past. Your history. When I was your age, I burned with ambition. I was very proud and my pride often hurt people. I made every wrong choice a young man can... But one thing saved me... I had a father who believed in me. Who took the time to teach me a better way. You have the same father. SHINZON Yes. PICARD So if I gave you my life, what would you do with it? Would you spend the years in a blaze of hatred as you are now? Or could you change? Could you try to remember a mother's touch you never felt? A father's words you never heard? Could you do that? SHINZON (quietly) I don't know. PICARD But you want to.

metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

document_metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

chunks.content: Shinzon doesn't respond. But Picard knows he has made a connection. For this brief moment reconciliation is possible. He proceeds quietly: PICARD Let me tell you about our father. Shinzon looks at him with an aching sadness. What might have been. SHINZON That's your life... not mine. PICARD Please. SHINZON It's too late. PICARD You can still make a choice! Make the right one now! SHINZON I have no choices! I can't fight what I am!

metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

chunks.content: Shinzon backs away, unable to fight his nature: SHINZON I'll show you my true nature. Your nature. And as Earth dies -- remember that I'm forever Shinzon of Remus! And my voice will echo through time long after yours has faded to a dim memory. Shinzon ends the transmission and his holographic image flickers and fades away.

metadata.title: 236、INT. ENTERPRISE - READY ROOM
metadata.summary: Shinzon rejects Picard's appeal, asserts his identity, and vows his legacy will outlast Picard's as he terminates the transmission.

document_metadata.title: 237、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon orders weapons disabled, but the Scimitar is rocked by an attack from two decloaking Romulan ships, stunning him and halting his command.

chunks.content: Shinzon strides quickly to his command chair, barking to his Viceroy: SHINZON Disable their weapons! But before the Viceroy can move the Scimitar suddenly ROCKS -- attacked from somewhere! Shinzon is stunned. SHINZON Report! REMAN OFFICER Two ships decloaking, sir! Romulan!

metadata.title: 237、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon orders weapons disabled, but the Scimitar is rocked by an attack from two decloaking Romulan ships, stunning him and halting his command.

document_metadata.title: 238、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Romulan Warbirds assist Enterprise against Shinzon; Donatra demands Romulan ale as Picard coordinates attack, with enemy ship illuminated by combined fire.

chunks.content: Picard strides to his command chair as two Romulan Warbirds appear on the viewscreen. Deanna is now on the bridge. RIKER Believe it or not, I think the cavalry has arrived. WORF We're being hailed. PICARD On screen. On the viewscreen: Commander Donatra shimmers into view. DONATRA (ON VIEWSCREEN) Captain Picard, Commander Donatra of the Warbird Valdore. Might we be of assistance? PICARD Your timing is impeccable, Commander. DONATRA (ON VIEWSCREEN) The Empire considers this a matter of internal security. We regret you've become involved.

metadata.title: 238、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Romulan Warbirds assist Enterprise against Shinzon; Donatra demands Romulan ale as Picard coordinates attack, with enemy ship illuminated by combined fire.

chunks.content: PICARD When this is over, I owe you a drink. On the viewscreen, the Valdore ROCKS from a disruptor blast. DONATRA (ON VIEWSCREEN) Romulan ale, Captain. Let's get to work. Valdore out. The transmission ends. PICARD (to Worf) You heard the lady. Get to work. Move your ass! (The Romulan Warbirds must remain decloaked to fire weapons and are visible throughout the battle.)Although Shinzon's ship is still cloaked, the steady barrage of triangulated phaser and disruptor fire from the Enterprise and the two Romulan vessels illuminate its shields with impacts.

metadata.title: 238、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Romulan Warbirds assist Enterprise against Shinzon; Donatra demands Romulan ale as Picard coordinates attack, with enemy ship illuminated by combined fire.

document_metadata.title: 239、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard orders Worf to coordinate attacks with the Valdore, targeting shield impacts. After a torpedo hit, Data reports aft shields at 40%. Riker directs the helm to keep the bow toward the Scimitar and reroute power to forward shields.

chunks.content: PICARD (to Worf) Coordinate our attack with the Valdore's tactical officer. Triangulate fire on any shield impacts. WORF Aye, sir. The Enterprise ROCKS from a photon torpedo impact -- DATA Aft shields are down to forty percent. RIKER (to Helm) Keep our bow to the Scimitar. Auxiliary power to forward shields.

metadata.title: 239、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard orders Worf to coordinate attacks with the Valdore, targeting shield impacts. After a torpedo hit, Data reports aft shields at 40%. Riker directs the helm to keep the bow toward the Scimitar and reroute power to forward shields.

document_metadata.title: 240、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon calmly commands his crew to target a flanking Warbird with all forward disruptor banks, preparing to fire on his mark.

chunks.content: Shinzon sits quite calmly in his command chair. SHINZON Target the flanking Warbird. All forward disruptor banks on my mark.

metadata.title: 240、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon calmly commands his crew to target a flanking Warbird with all forward disruptor banks, preparing to fire on his mark.

document_metadata.title: 241、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise and two Romulan Warbirds engage the Scimitar in a chaotic battle; the Scimitar destroys one Warbird, sending debris that strikes the Enterprise.

chunks.content: It is a chaos of starships as the Enterprise and the two Warbirds fire steadily -- illuminating the Scimitar's shields. The ships sweep around one another, maneuvering for position, firing constantly. The battlefield seems impossibly crowded as the four vessels evade and attack; as phaser and disruptor beams criss-cross space. Then the Scimitar unleashes a devastating volley... all her forward disruptor banks fire at once -- They literally cut one of the Romulan ships in half -- a huge EXPLOSION -- debris SHOOTS across space and SLAMS VIOLENTLY off the Enterprise's forward shields -- !

metadata.title: 241、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise and two Romulan Warbirds engage the Scimitar in a chaotic battle; the Scimitar destroys one Warbird, sending debris that strikes the Enterprise.

document_metadata.title: 242、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The ship is rocking dangerously; forward shields are at 10%. Riker orders the helm to bring the ship about.

chunks.content: The ship ROCKS dangerously! DATA Forward shields are down to ten percent. RIKER (to Helm) Bring us about!

metadata.title: 242、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The ship is rocking dangerously; forward shields are at 10%. Riker orders the helm to bring the ship about.

document_metadata.title: 243、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise fires its aft phasers while turning, as the Valdore approaches Shinzon's ship and opens fire.

chunks.content: The Enterprise quickly turns about -- firing her aft phasers, as the Valdore sweeps toward Shinzon's ship, firing --

metadata.title: 243、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise fires its aft phasers while turning, as the Valdore approaches Shinzon's ship and opens fire.

document_metadata.title: 244、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon orders to drop cloak on aft port quadrant and prepare for emergency stop, surprising the Viceroy.

chunks.content: SHINZON Let her pursue -- drop cloak on the aft port quadrant and prepare for full emergency stop. VICEROY (startled) What?! SHINZON You heard me.

metadata.title: 244、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon orders to drop cloak on aft port quadrant and prepare for emergency stop, surprising the Viceroy.

document_metadata.title: 245、INT. VALDORE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Donatra observes the Scimitar's cloaking failing and orders her crew to prepare forward disruptor banks for action.

chunks.content: Donatra leans forward in her command chair, looking at viewscreen. She sees part of the Scimitar's rear cloakning fall away -- DONATRA She's losing her cloak! Stand by all forward disruptor banks!

metadata.title: 245、INT. VALDORE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Donatra observes the Scimitar's cloaking failing and orders her crew to prepare forward disruptor banks for action.

document_metadata.title: 246、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Valdore pursues the ship, gaining on it; the Reman crew grows nervous as Shinzon orders a full stop and fire.

chunks.content: VICEROY She's almost on us. SHINZON Not yet. On the viewscreen we see the Valdore in pursuit, gaining. The Reman crew is getting nervous. VICEROY Praetor... SHINZON FULL STOP AND FIRE !

metadata.title: 246、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Valdore pursues the ship, gaining on it; the Reman crew grows nervous as Shinzon orders a full stop and fire.

document_metadata.title: 247、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Scimitar abruptly stops, causing the Valdore to overshoot; it is then hit by torpedoes, losing control and drifting disabled in space.

chunks.content: The Scimitar LURCHES to a stop! Too fast for the Valdore to respond in time -- it flies over the Scimitar -- And the Scimitar fires! A devastating volley of photon torpedoes rip into the underbelly and aft of the Valdore as it streaks past -- The Valdore careens out of control and then slows to a stop. It floats dead in space.

metadata.title: 247、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Scimitar abruptly stops, causing the Valdore to overshoot; it is then hit by torpedoes, losing control and drifting disabled in space.

document_metadata.title: 248、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon orders the aft cloak restored and the ship turned, preparing for the final battle from his command chair.

chunks.content: SHINZON Restore the aft cloak.and bring us about. He leans back in his command chair, ready for the final battle.

metadata.title: 248、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon orders the aft cloak restored and the ship turned, preparing for the final battle from his command chair.

document_metadata.title: 249、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Commander Donatra's ship is disabled and damaged, with temporary life support, as she speaks to Picard before the vessel is rocked by an impact.

chunks.content: A bloody Commander Donatra is talking to Picard on viewscreen. Her bridge is in ruins. DONATRA (ON VIEWSCREEN) I'm afraid that drink will have to wait, Captain. PICARD Do you have life support? DONATRA (ON VIEWSCREEN) For the moment. But we're dead in the water. PICARD Understood -- Then the ship ROCKS --

metadata.title: 249、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Commander Donatra's ship is disabled and damaged, with temporary life support, as she speaks to Picard before the vessel is rocked by an impact.

document_metadata.title: 250、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The invisible Scimitar launches a brutal attack on the Enterprise, causing massive explosions and tearing away several decks.

chunks.content: The invisible Scimitar sweeps past for a particularly brutal assault -- disruptor blasts streak along the Enterprise's hull -- a huge, ripping series of explosions tear away several decks of the Enterprise --

metadata.title: 250、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The invisible Scimitar launches a brutal attack on the Enterprise, causing massive explosions and tearing away several decks.

document_metadata.title: 251、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Structural damage on decks twelve to seventeen; emergency fields active. Riker orders evacuation and shield reinforcement. Deanna suggests using her connection to locate targets, approved by Picard.

chunks.content: DATA We have lost structural integrity on decks twelve through seventeen, sections four through ten. GEORDI Emergency force fields are holding. RIKER Evacuate those decks and reroute field power to forward shields. Deanna goes to Picard: DEANNA Captain -- I might have a way to find them. PICARD Counselor? DEANNA The one thing he may have forgotten in the course of battle: me. PICARD Make it so. She quickly goes to Worf at tactical.

metadata.title: 251、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Structural damage on decks twelve to seventeen; emergency fields active. Riker orders evacuation and shield reinforcement. Deanna suggests using her connection to locate targets, approved by Picard.

document_metadata.title: 252、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon inputs tactical commands to prepare a lateral run with starboard disruptors, but the viceroy reacts with alarm.

chunks.content: Shinzon is entering tactical commands in his chair console. SHINZON Prepare a lateral run -- all starboard disruptors. Then the viceroy suddenly stiffens, alarm in his eyes -- VICEROY No!

metadata.title: 252、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon inputs tactical commands to prepare a lateral run with starboard disruptors, but the viceroy reacts with alarm.

document_metadata.title: 253、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Deanna struggles to telepathically guide Worf's hand on the targeting display, experiencing pain as he resists her mental connection.

chunks.content: Deanna concentrates furiously, eyes closed. She stands with Worf, her hand slowly moving his over the photon torpedo targeting display. It is a wrenching experience as she probes with her thoughts. DEANNA He's resisting me. She is in pain.

metadata.title: 253、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Deanna struggles to telepathically guide Worf's hand on the targeting display, experiencing pain as he resists her mental connection.

document_metadata.title: 254、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Viceroy senses her presence, causing Shinzon to demand focus on their task.

chunks.content: The Viceroy concentrates, trying to block her probing thoughts. SHINZON What is it?! Focus on your job!!! VICEROY She is here.

metadata.title: 254、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Viceroy senses her presence, causing Shinzon to demand focus on their task.

document_metadata.title: 255、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Deanna struggles to control Worf's hand on the targeting display, visibly strained and focused.

chunks.content: Deanna continues to move Worf's hand over the targeting display. She is sweating, panting for breath, concentrating fiercely.

metadata.title: 255、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Deanna struggles to control Worf's hand on the targeting display, visibly strained and focused.

document_metadata.title: 256、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Deanna confronts the Viceroy mentally, their psyches clashing as she appears in his mind and challenges him with a haunting question.

chunks.content: The Viceroy resists her -- their psyches lock in battle. Deanna appears in the Viceroy's mind, she glares at him. DEANNA Remember me?

metadata.title: 256、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Deanna confronts the Viceroy mentally, their psyches clashing as she appears in his mind and challenges him with a haunting question.

document_metadata.title: 257、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Deanna is urgently called as Worf fires a full volley of photon torpedoes.

chunks.content: Her eyes snap open -- DEANNA NOW! Worf instantly fires a full volley of photon torpedoes.

metadata.title: 257、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Deanna is urgently called as Worf fires a full volley of photon torpedoes.

document_metadata.title: 258、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: Photon torpedoes hit their target, causing a series of impacts that disable the Scimitar's cloaking system.

chunks.content: A full spread of photon torpedoes shoot through space. And connect! A series of devastating impacts -- and the Scimitar's cloak fails!

metadata.title: 258、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: Photon torpedoes hit their target, causing a series of impacts that disable the Scimitar's cloaking system.

document_metadata.title: 259、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard reacts abruptly, urging savagery against an unspecified threat or enemy.

chunks.content: Picard stands quickly. PICARD Savage them!

metadata.title: 259、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard reacts abruptly, urging savagery against an unspecified threat or enemy.

document_metadata.title: 260、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise attacks the Scimitar with phasers and torpedoes; the Scimitar maneuvers and returns fire.

chunks.content: And the Enterprise attacks! It fires all weapons simultaneously -- phasers and photon torpedoes slam into the Scimitar! Shinzon's ship responds quickly -- maneuvering for position and returning fire!

metadata.title: 260、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise attacks the Scimitar with phasers and torpedoes; the Scimitar maneuvers and returns fire.

document_metadata.title: 261、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, desperate, orders a boarding party to capture Picard, restores the cloak, and directs concentrated disruptor fire at the Enterprise's beta three shield coordinates.

chunks.content: The bridge has been damaged, sparks sputter through the darkness and debris litters the deck. Shinzon eyes reflect a growing sense of desperation. SHINZON (spinning to his Viceroy) Prepare a boarding party -- BRING ME PICARD! The viceroy strides out as Shinzon spins to another officer. SHINZON Get the cloak back! And target shield coordinates beta three. All disruptors. Fire! On the viewscreen, we see disruptor beams focusing on a tiny part of the Enterprise's lower shields, slamming into them.

metadata.title: 261、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon, desperate, orders a boarding party to capture Picard, restores the cloak, and directs concentrated disruptor fire at the Enterprise's beta three shield coordinates.

document_metadata.title: 262、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise loses ventral shielding on deck twenty-nine; Riker and Worf respond to an intruder alert while Data takes tactical control.

chunks.content: DATA Captain, we have lost ventral shielding on deck twenty nine. PICARD Divert power and compensate -- An alarm klaxon suddenly rings through the bridge. WORF Intruder alert! RIKER Let's go. Riker and Worf quickly head toward the turbolift as: WORF (to comm) Security detail to deck twenty nine. Data immediately assumes Worf's position at tactical.

metadata.title: 262、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: The Enterprise loses ventral shielding on deck twenty-nine; Riker and Worf respond to an intruder alert while Data takes tactical control.

document_metadata.title: 263、INT. ENTERPRISE - LOWER DECKS - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Riker and Worf gain advantage against Remans; Worf provides cover fire as Riker pursues the fleeing Viceroy into a Jefferies tube to confront him.

chunks.content: Riker and Worf stride with a SECURITY DETAIL through the cramped lower decks. A sudden disruptor blast stops them cold! The Viceroy and his invasion force of a dozen Reman Warriors are down the corridor! The Enterprise crew returns fire. It is a blazing phaser battle, Worf leading his men with Klingon courage. They steadily advance in the face of the blistering disruptor fire, holding their ground and pushing forward against the enemy's relentless assault.

metadata.title: 263、INT. ENTERPRISE - LOWER DECKS - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Riker and Worf gain advantage against Remans; Worf provides cover fire as Riker pursues the fleeing Viceroy into a Jefferies tube to confront him.

chunks.content: They are getting the upper hand when Riker sees the Viceroy escape into a Jefferies tube. RIKER Worf. Worf instantly dives into the corridor -- landing hard and sliding forward on his stomach all the while firing a steady burst from his phaser rifle. The security team regroups, maintaining suppressive fire as the Remans fall back under the coordinated assault.Riker uses the cover to dive after the Viceroy, following him into the dark Jefferies tube, intent on destroying the man who has been tormenting his wife --

metadata.title: 263、INT. ENTERPRISE - LOWER DECKS - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Riker and Worf gain advantage against Remans; Worf provides cover fire as Riker pursues the fleeing Viceroy into a Jefferies tube to confront him.

document_metadata.title: 264、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard realizes the Scimitar's cloaking maneuver is intentional, aiming to confront him directly as the enemy vessel turns and begins to vanish, leaving the crew in suspense.

chunks.content: The Scimitar sweeps into view on the viewscreen -- filling the screen -- and launches a ferocious volley of photon torpedoes. A huge EXPLOSION as the viewscreen and some of the forward bridge are BLOWN APART -- the Helm Officer is SUCKED INTO SPACE before a flickering emergency force field springs into position. Deanna races to assume the helm, and Picard can now see his enemy directly through the gaping hole in the ship's hull. He sees the Scimitar banking for another attack run as part of the ship disappears. Geordi reports that the enemy is regaining its cloak and that they have exhausted their photon torpedoes, with phaser banks down to four percent.

metadata.title: 264、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard realizes the Scimitar's cloaking maneuver is intentional, aiming to confront him directly as the enemy vessel turns and begins to vanish, leaving the crew in suspense.

chunks.content: Picard considers a concentrated phaser attack, but Data confirms the Scimitar's shields are still at seventy percent, rendering such an effort ineffective. The crew falls silent as they watch the enemy vessel through the breach in the hull. The Scimitar slows, then stops advancing, beginning a slow turn as more of it vanishes under the returning cloak. Geordi voices the crew's confusion, wondering what the enemy is doing. Picard, his expression grim, realizes the intent behind the maneuver.He wants to look me in the eye.

metadata.title: 264、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard realizes the Scimitar's cloaking maneuver is intentional, aiming to confront him directly as the enemy vessel turns and begins to vanish, leaving the crew in suspense.

document_metadata.title: 265、INT. ENTERPRISE - JEFFERIES TUBE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Riker hunts the Viceroy in dark tunnels of a crippled ship; the Viceroy, able to see in darkness, ambushes Riker from the ceiling with a knife.

chunks.content: Below decks, Riker stalks the Viceroy through a labyrinthine series of access tunnels. It is like a scene from ALIEN. The flickering half-light and red emergency strobes of the crippled ship make this an ominous sequence. The Viceroy is in his element, used to the perpetual night of the Reman Homeworld, he can see in the dark. Riker moves through the darkness, hunting for the Viceroy. He stops, phaser ready. He peers into the dark tunnel ahead of him. Sees nothing. We tilt up and see... The Viceroy clinging to the ceiling directly above Riker! Hidden in the darkness. The Viceroy attacks! -- diving down on Riker -- his lethal Reman knife slashing through the darkness --

metadata.title: 265、INT. ENTERPRISE - JEFFERIES TUBE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Riker hunts the Viceroy in dark tunnels of a crippled ship; the Viceroy, able to see in darkness, ambushes Riker from the ceiling with a knife.

document_metadata.title: 266、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard realizes the enemy anticipates his move, then quickly devises a new plan and inputs commands to outmaneuver the cloaked Scimitar near the Enterprise.

chunks.content: Picard stands... watching the Scimitar maneuver into position. Large parts of it are now cloaked. It stops. Only a few hundred yards from the Enterprise, its great prow almost filling the gaping hole at the front of the bridge. Picard thinks, his mind racing. Then it comes to him in a flash: PICARD He thinks he knows exactly what I'm going to do... GEORDI Sir? PICARD We've got him! He sits in his command chair and begins quickly entering command instructions in his chair console.

metadata.title: 266、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard realizes the enemy anticipates his move, then quickly devises a new plan and inputs commands to outmaneuver the cloaked Scimitar near the Enterprise.

document_metadata.title: 267、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, confident, orders a channel to be opened from his command chair.

chunks.content: Shinzon, supremely confident, leans back in his command chair. SHINZON Open a channel.

metadata.title: 267、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon, confident, orders a channel to be opened from his command chair.

document_metadata.title: 268、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard recalls his overconfidence during Academy days, then redirects power to engines and orders Deanna to engage, preparing for impact as Enterprise faces imminent collision.

chunks.content: Picard is still entering commands in his chair console. DATA We are being hailed. PICARD Deanna, stand by. (to Data) Open a channel. SHINZON (V.O.) I hope you're still alive, Jean Luc. PICARD I am. SHINZON (V.O.) Don't you think it's time to surrender? I'll have my cloak back in a matter of minutes and your poor ship is shot to pieces. Why should the rest of your crew have to die? Picard continues to enter command codes -- transmits them to Deanna at helm -- she receives the commands, nods. All of this as Picard buys some time.

metadata.title: 268、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard recalls his overconfidence during Academy days, then redirects power to engines and orders Deanna to engage, preparing for impact as Enterprise faces imminent collision.

chunks.content: PICARD I never told you about my first Academy evaluation, did I? I received very high marks for my studies. But I was found lacking in certain other areas. Personality traits, you might say. In particular I was thought to be extremely... (he glares up at the prow of the Scimitar) ... over-confident. Picard indicates for Data to end the communication. Then: PICARD (quickly) Geordi, put 211 power to the engines. Take it from life support if you have to -- everything you can give me. GEORDI Aye, sir. PICARD Deanna, on my mark. GEORDI Ready, sir!PICARD (on comm) All hands, brace for impact! (to Deanna) ENGAGE.

metadata.title: 268、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard recalls his overconfidence during Academy days, then redirects power to engines and orders Deanna to engage, preparing for impact as Enterprise faces imminent collision.

document_metadata.title: 269、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise moves forward with a final powerful thrust.

chunks.content: The Enterprise powers forward in a final thrust -- !

metadata.title: 269、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise moves forward with a final powerful thrust.

document_metadata.title: 270、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon is caught off guard and attempts to evade too late as the event unfolds suddenly and unavoidably.

chunks.content: Shinzon sees it coming -- utterly shocked -- bolts up -- SHINZON HARD TO PORT ! Too late.

metadata.title: 270、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon is caught off guard and attempts to evade too late as the event unfolds suddenly and unavoidably.

document_metadata.title: 271、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise collides violently with the Scimitar, causing the latter to reel from the impact.

chunks.content: A massive COLLISION as the Enterprise SLAMS into the Scimitar -- as it SMASHES and GRINDS into Shinzon's ship -- The Scimitar REELS --

metadata.title: 271、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise collides violently with the Scimitar, causing the latter to reel from the impact.

document_metadata.title: 272、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Everyone is flying, indicating a shared experience of flight.

chunks.content: Everyone goes FLYING!

metadata.title: 272、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Everyone is flying, indicating a shared experience of flight.

document_metadata.title: 273、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise and Shinzon's ship are locked together, slowly rotating in space like two entangled scorpions.

chunks.content: The two great ships are now locked together, slowly rotating in space. The forward part of the Enterprise's saucer is enmeshed in Shinzon's ship; two scorpions with their claws locked.

metadata.title: 273、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise and Shinzon's ship are locked together, slowly rotating in space like two entangled scorpions.

document_metadata.title: 274、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, in the ruined bridge amid dead crew, orders all power diverted to engines for full reverse.

chunks.content: Shinzon stands in the ruins of his bridge. Many of his bridge crew are now dead. SHINZON Divert all power to engines. Full reverse!

metadata.title: 274、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon, in the ruined bridge amid dead crew, orders all power diverted to engines for full reverse.

document_metadata.title: 275、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise and Scimitar violently separate, tearing apart as the Scimitar wrenches free, damaging both ships in the process.

chunks.content: Every part of the Enterprise ROCKS -- a great lurch as the Scimitar begins to tear itself free -- backing away -- a deafening shriek of metal -- both ships are being torn to pieces in the process -- but it is working -- the Scimitar is ripping free, wrenching itself loose.

metadata.title: 275、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise and Scimitar violently separate, tearing apart as the Scimitar wrenches free, damaging both ships in the process.

document_metadata.title: 276、INT. ENTERPRISE - JEFFERIES TUBES - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Riker grabs a ladder during a fall, struggles with the Viceroy clinging to him, and pushes him off, causing the Viceroy to fall to his death.

chunks.content: The Jefferies tube SHUDDERS as the Scimitar continues to tear itself free -- Riker and the Viceroy careen through the tube. The Viceroy recovers quickly and coils for a final attack. Riker sees that an access plate has been loosened in the collision -- he desperately rips it away -- knowing the relays behind will provide him with the advantage he needs -- Bright light strobes from the relays and the Viceroy is momentarily blinded -- Riker uses this opportunity to attack! He dives forward -- slamming into the Viceroy -- they both tumble into a long, vertical access tunnel -- they fall!

metadata.title: 276、INT. ENTERPRISE - JEFFERIES TUBES - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Riker grabs a ladder during a fall, struggles with the Viceroy clinging to him, and pushes him off, causing the Viceroy to fall to his death.

chunks.content: Riker shoots out a hand and grabs a ladder -- the Viceroy, grabs onto Riker, his talons digging into his uniform -- a long drop below them! Riker forces the Viceroy's head back -- away from him -- a brutal struggle -- Riker glares at him. RIKER Don't worry -- Hell is dark. Riker uses every ounce of strength he has left -- pushes the Viceroy off him -- The Viceroy falls down the long tunnel -- to his death.

metadata.title: 276、INT. ENTERPRISE - JEFFERIES TUBES - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Riker grabs a ladder during a fall, struggles with the Viceroy clinging to him, and pushes him off, causing the Viceroy to fall to his death.

document_metadata.title: 277、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise bridge shakes as the Scimitar frees itself; Picard initiates auto-destruct, but it fails. The Scimitar retreats, reactivating its cloak.

chunks.content: The whole Enterprise bridge QUAKES as the Scimitar continues to pull itself free -- Picard stands, steadying himself on his command chair. PICARD Data, I need you. Data joins Picard as: PICARD Computer. Auto-destruct sequence Omega. Zero time delay. Recognize voice pattern Jean Luc Picard. Authorization Alpha Alpha Three Zero Five -- COMPUTER (V.O.) Auto-destruct is off-line. Then the ship gives a final LURCH. The Scimitar is free. An eerie moment of silence after the explosive tearing and grinding. Picard watches through the gaping hole in the hull as the Scimitar backs away. Another section of the Scimitar disappears. Shinzon almost has his cloak back.

metadata.title: 277、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: The Enterprise bridge shakes as the Scimitar frees itself; Picard initiates auto-destruct, but it fails. The Scimitar retreats, reactivating its cloak.

document_metadata.title: 278、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon, weakening and facing death, orders the destruction of the Enterprise to advance his goal of reaching Earth, despite needing Picard to survive, declaring some ideals worth dying for.

chunks.content: Shinzon stares at the Enterprise. A wave of sickness overcomes him for a moment, he doubles over. We actually see more veins appearing on his face. Time is running out. SHINZON Target disruptors. Destroy them. REMAN OFFICER Disruptors are off-line, sir. A beat. Shinzon looks up. SHINZON Deploy the weapon. Kill everything on that ship. Then set a course for Earth. REMAN OFFICER What about Picard? SHINZON Our greater goal is more important, brother. REMAN OFFICER But, Praetor, you won't survive without him... Shinzon gazes at the Enterprise on the viewscreen. SHINZON Some ideals are worth dying for, aren't they, Jean Luc?

metadata.title: 278、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Shinzon, weakening and facing death, orders the destruction of the Enterprise to advance his goal of reaching Earth, despite needing Picard to survive, declaring some ideals worth dying for.

document_metadata.title: 279、EXT. RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Scimitar unfolds to reveal a large spider-like weapon with legs, deploying the deadly Cascading Pulse.

chunks.content: The entire Scimitar slowly begins to unfold. Like a gigantic version of the small spider-weapon we saw kill the Romulan Senators before, legs appear and hoist up a savage weapon. The Cascading Pulse.

metadata.title: 279、EXT. RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Scimitar unfolds to reveal a large spider-like weapon with legs, deploying the deadly Cascading Pulse.

document_metadata.title: 280、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard transports to confront the threat as Data takes command after transporters fail, ordering the ship to move away from the Scimitar.

chunks.content: Picard and the others watch the monstrous Cascading Pulse weapon slowly deploying. PICARD How long until he can fire? GEORDI The targeting sequence should take about four minutes. DEANNA But how can he? He'll kill you. PICARD This isn't about me anymore. Picard's face is set, resolute. He knows what he must do. Picard grabs a phaser rifle from a weapons locker as... PICARD Prepare for a site-to-site transport. GEORDI (concerned) Sir, we won't be able to bring you back. It's a one way trip. Captain, I don't know if the transporter -- PICARD That's an order, Commander. DATA Sir, allow me to go. You are needed here. PICARD Negative. DATA Sir... Deanna takes Data's arm. Looks at him. She knows this is something Picard must do himself. DEANNA Let him go.

metadata.title: 280、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard transports to confront the threat as Data takes command after transporters fail, ordering the ship to move away from the Scimitar.

chunks.content: Picard powers up the phaser rifle as: PICARD (to Data) You have the bridge, Commander. Use all available power to move away from the Scimitar. (to Geordi) Now, Mister La Forge. GEORDI Aye, sir. Geordi nervously works some controls on his console and Picard dematerializes. Then the transporter panel explodes in a shower of sparks. GEORDI That's it. Transporters are down. Data thinks for a moment. Then: DATA Counsellor Troi, please assume command. Geordi, if you will come with me. He heads toward the turbolift, Geordi following.

metadata.title: 280、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard transports to confront the threat as Data takes command after transporters fail, ordering the ship to move away from the Scimitar.

document_metadata.title: 281、INT. SCIMITAR - CORRIDOR - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Remen warriors fire at Riker, who quickly returns fire with his phaser rifle in a corridor confrontation.

chunks.content: Several Remen warriors in the corridor turn and fire. Riker returns fire, a series of lightning fast pulses from his phaser rifle.

metadata.title: 281、INT. SCIMITAR - CORRIDOR - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Remen warriors fire at Riker, who quickly returns fire with his phaser rifle in a corridor confrontation.

document_metadata.title: 282、INT. ENTERPRISE - FORWARD CORRIDOR - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Data and Geordi prepare in a corridor ending in space; with force fields active, Data thanks Geordi, who deactivates the field, allowing Data to run and leap into space.

chunks.content: Data and Geordi stand in a long corridor. The far end of the corridor opens to space. An emergency force field is in place at the end of the corridor. Geordi operates a tricorder and another force field flickers on around him. Data looks toward the end of the corridor, readying himself. DATA What is our approximate distance? GEORDI (scans with tricorder) meters. DATA Thank you. Data backs up a little more He looks at Geordi again. Deeply. DATA Thank you, Geordi. Deactivate the field. Geordi operates his tricorder and the force field at the end of the corridor snaps off -- The void of space fills the corridor and Data takes a running start -- he races down the long corridor and leaps --

metadata.title: 282、INT. ENTERPRISE - FORWARD CORRIDOR - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Data and Geordi prepare in a corridor ending in space; with force fields active, Data thanks Geordi, who deactivates the field, allowing Data to run and leap into space.

document_metadata.title: 283、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: Data floats through space, nearly missing the Scimitar, but collides with its cloaked section, grabs hold, and enters the ship by force.

chunks.content: -- into space. He floats toward the Scimitar, his momentum carrying him. Carrying him too far! He is going to miss the Scimitar -- almost past it now! He thrusts out a hand -- And just misses a piece of dangling wreckage! Data is floating helplessly through space. Doomed. Then he SLAMS into an invisible piece of the partially cloaked on the ship! He grabs onto the invisible part of the ship and pulls himself up to the hull. He rips open an access panel with his superior strength and climbs inside.

metadata.title: 283、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: Data floats through space, nearly missing the Scimitar, but collides with its cloaked section, grabs hold, and enters the ship by force.

document_metadata.title: 284、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Shinzon impales himself on a spear, pins Picard, and declares their destiny complete as Data activates an emergency transport to save Picard, then sacrifices himself by destroying the Scimitar's warp core.

chunks.content: Shinzon stands, his eyes glued to the Enterprise on the viewscreen. We see a monitor showing that the Cascading Pulse weapon is locked on the Enterprise. Most of the light on the shattered bridge now comes from the three steadily pulsing warp core relays which soar up through the floor. COMPUTER (V.O) Forty-seven. Forty six... Suddenly -- a MASSIVE BLAST as the doors to the bridge explode in. Shinzon spins to see -- Picard framed in the doorway, phaser rifle ready. Picard instantly fires for the Cascading Pulse control -- but Shinzon dives to cover it -- the phaser blast hits Shinzon in the chest -- he recoils, slamming to the deck, stunned. The few remaining Remans on the bridge spin to Picard, firing disruptors -- Picard dives for cover and battles them with his phaser rifle -- He succeeds in stunning the Remans but a final disruptor blast knocks Picard to the deck -- the phaser rifle spins away -- COMPUTER (V.O.) Twenty nine... Twenty eight... Shinzon pulls himself up and races to snatch up a disruptor from a fallen comrade -- As Picard leaps up, grabbing a piece of wreckage, a long metal rod -- Picard thrusts it forward like a spear -- Impaling Shinzon.

metadata.title: 284、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon impales himself on a spear, pins Picard, and declares their destiny complete as Data activates an emergency transport to save Picard, then sacrifices himself by destroying the Scimitar's warp core.

chunks.content: A stunned moment of silence as Shinzon gazes at Picard, almost with a look of disbelief. Blood spews from his mouth as he lets out a tormented cry. And then, amazingly, Shinzon forces himself forward -- pushing Picard back against a wall -- Shinzon slowly walks toward Picard, forcing himself down the length of the spear -- the spear point explodes through Shinzon's back -- the weight of Shinzon's body is pinning Picard against the wall -- time is running out -- COMPUTER (V.O.) Eighteen... Seventeen... Shinzon forces himself down the spear: SHINZON I'm glad we're together now -- our destiny is complete. He finally thrusts himself down the whole spear and clasps his dying hands firmly around Picard's throat -- COMPUTER (V.O.) Ten...Nine... Data sprints to the bridge -- He instantly tears open his wrist and pulls out the small, silver disc we saw earlier -- the Emergency Transport Unit -- he slaps it on Picard's shoulder. A final look between them -- COMPUTER (V.O.) Seven.. Six... Data activates the ETU -- Picard dematerializes. Data looks at the space where Picard was and says simply: DATA Goodbye.Then he spins and pulls out his phaser -- And fires point-blank into the Scimitar's warp core relays -- the bridge explodes -- Data is incinerated --

metadata.title: 284、INT. SCIMITAR - BRIDGE - NIGHT
metadata.summary: Shinzon impales himself on a spear, pins Picard, and declares their destiny complete as Data activates an emergency transport to save Picard, then sacrifices himself by destroying the Scimitar's warp core.

document_metadata.title: 285、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Scimitar explodes in a massive flash.

chunks.content: The Scimitar BLASTS APART in a massive flash --

metadata.title: 285、EXT. THE RIFT - SPACE
metadata.summary: The Scimitar explodes in a massive flash.

document_metadata.title: 286、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
document_metadata.summary: Picard arranges for medical aid from Commander Donatra, delegates duties, and retreats to his Ready Room as the crew mourns, overwhelmed by recent trauma.

chunks.content: Picard re-materializes. He sees the brilliant flash from the explosion through the gaping hole in the front of the bridge. Deanna sits at helm, her face a mask of pain. Geordi stands on the upper rear deck, head down. A long beat as Picard just stands on his ruined bridge, the thousand-yard stare of a combat veteran in his eyes. Riker emerges from the turbolift. Goes to Picard. RIKER Sir? Picard doesn't answer, he just stares forward. Deanna goes to Riker. DEANNA Data. Riker looks toward the glowing debris field in the distance. He puts an arm around Deanna. Silence. GEORDI Sir, we're being hailed. PICARD On screen... (he remembers there is no longer a viewscreen) ... Open a channel.

metadata.title: 286、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard arranges for medical aid from Commander Donatra, delegates duties, and retreats to his Ready Room as the crew mourns, overwhelmed by recent trauma.

chunks.content: DONATRA (V.O.) This is Commander Donatra of the Valdore. We're dispatching shuttles with medical personnel and supplies. PICARD Thank you, Commander. The transmission ends. PICARD (flat) Geordi... prepare the shuttlebay for arrivals. They don't know our procedures so just... open the doors. GEORDI I'll take care of it, sir. PICARD Number One. (a beat) You have the bridge. He turns and heads toward his Ready Room. The others watch him go with great sadness.When the Ready Room doors close behind Picard, Deanna finally allows herself to cry. Riker holds her closely. Slow fade to

metadata.title: 286、INT. ENTERPRISE - BRIDGE - FOLLOWING
metadata.summary: Picard arranges for medical aid from Commander Donatra, delegates duties, and retreats to his Ready Room as the crew mourns, overwhelmed by recent trauma.

document_metadata.title: 287、INT. ENTERPRISE - CREW LOUNGE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The senior crew mourns Data's loss in the damaged lounge, wearing dress uniforms and adding mourning bands, then toasts him with Picard's wine.

chunks.content: Hours later. The senior crew is solemnly gathered in the shattered remains of the crew lounge. Picard, Riker, Deanna, Beverly, Worf, Geordi. They wear their dress uniforms. Picard goes to each of them. He carries a small, metal box. They each take something from the box. At first we, don't quite see what they are doing. Then we realize they are affixing black bars to the collars of their uniforms. Mourning bands. Picard pours six glasses of his precious Chateau Picard. Each takes a glass. Picard raises his glass.
